item.title: Cell 'Glue' Protein Found to Have a Second Function
item.description: Scientists found that E-cadherin, a protein known for holding cells together, also performs a surprising second job in the body.

item.title: Oklahoma Meteor Crater Found to Be 100 Million Years Younger
item.description: A buried meteor crater in Oklahoma is nearly 100 million years younger than previously believed, according to zircon crystal analysis.

item.title: Gut bacteria may indicate brain aging speed
item.description: A UCLA study connects faster brain aging to specific gut bacteria and chemical byproducts, with older-looking brains also linked to poorer memory.

item.title: Scientists find clue to universe expansion discrepancy
item.description: Tiny magnetic fields from shortly after the Big Bang may help explain the long-running disagreement over how fast the universe is expanding.
